test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

______ from humans, lions are the key natural predators of elephants.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aside**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Aside**" means to one side; out of the way, which fits the context of the sentence. (एक तरफ; रास्ते से बाहर)
 
• The sentence is talking about natural predators of elephants, so the word used should indicate a separation or distinction between humans and lions.
 
• Other options do not convey the same meaning as "aside" in this
